products.emptyDescription: Add your first product to start building the catalog.
products.formDescription: Add a clear name and description for this product. These details help your team identify and manage products in the catalog.

form.description: Create and publish a new furniture product to your store catalog.

updateForm.title: Update Product
updateForm.description: Modify product specifications, bilingual translations, and media gallery.

images.label: Product Gallery Images

collections.title: Collections
collections.listDescription: Group related products into collections to keep your catalog easy to browse. Create collections and update their details as your product range changes.
collections.emptyDescription: Add a collection to organize related products.
collections.formDescription: Choose a clear collection name and describe which products it represents. This helps keep related items organized in your catalog.

form.title: Add New Collection
form.description: Create a collection to organize related furniture products.

updateForm.title: Update Collection
updateForm.description: Edit the collection details to keep your furniture catalog organized.

arName.label: Arabic Name
arName.description: Enter the collection name in Arabic as it should appear to users.

enName.label: English Name
enName.description: Enter the collection name in English as it should appear to users.

icon.label: Lucide Icon Name
icon.description: Enter only the icon name from Lucide, such as 'sofa'. Do not include JSX tags like <Sofa />. Browse available icons at lucide.dev.

banners.title: Banners
banners.listDescription: Manage the promotional banners displayed in your store. Upload images, arrange their order, and keep your storefront content up to date.
banners.emptyDescription: Upload your first banner image to feature promotions and content in your store.
banners.formDescription: Upload banner images with a recommended size of 1920 × 1000 pixels. Drag and drop images to arrange their display order.

form.title: Add New Banner
form.description: Upload and arrange banner images for your storefront.

updateForm.title: Update Banner
updateForm.description: Manage your banner images and adjust their display order.

title.label: Banner Title
title.description: Enter a title to help identify this banner in your dashboard.

images.label: Banner Images
images.description: Upload one or more images in 1920 × 1000 pixels for the best display quality.
images.dropzone: Drag and drop images here, or click to browse
images.reorder: Drag images to change their display order
images.uploadError: Failed to upload image. Please try again.

offers.title: Offers
offers.listDescription: Create and manage promotional offers, set discount percentages, schedule validity dates, and customize promotional banners.
offers.emptyDescription: Create an offer to promote your products.

filters.title: Filter offers
filters.emptyDescription: Try changing your filters or create a new offer.

form.title: Add New Offer
form.description: Set up a promotional offer with a discount, validity period, and optional banner.

updateForm.title: Update Offer
updateForm.description: Edit the offer details, discount, schedule, and banner settings.

arName.label: Arabic Name
arName.description: Enter the offer name in Arabic as it will appear to users.

enName.label: English Name
enName.description: Enter the offer name in English as it will appear to users.

arDescription.label: Arabic Description
arDescription.description: Write a short description of the offer in Arabic. This field is optional.

enDescription.label: English Description
enDescription.description: Write a short description of the offer in English. This field is optional.

arBannerText.label: Arabic Banner Text
arBannerText.description: Text shown on the promotional banner in Arabic. Optional.

enBannerText.label: English Banner Text
enBannerText.description: Text shown on the promotional banner in English. Optional.

percentage.label: Discount Percentage
percentage.description: Enter a number between 1 and 100. E.g., type 20 for a 20% discount.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: Set the offer start date. Past dates cannot be selected.

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: Set the offer end date. It must be after the start date.

isActive.label: Active Offer
isActive.hint: Enable this to make the offer visible and available to users immediately after saving.

showBanner.label: Show Banner
showBanner.description: Display a promotional banner for this offer.
showBanner.hint: Enable this to display the promotional banner configured in the previous step.

bannerBackgroundColor.label: Banner Background Color
bannerBackgroundColor.description: Enter the background color in hex format. E.g. #2563eb

bannerTextColor.label: Banner Text Color
bannerTextColor.description: Enter the text color in hex format. E.g. #ffffff

messages.title: Messages
messages.listDescription: Review messages sent by your customers and keep track of incoming questions or feedback in one place.

filters.title: Filter messages
filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, phone, or subject...

priorities.highDesc: Requires immediate attention. Includes damaged or defective furniture, serious complaints, delayed or failed deliveries, and urgent order issues.
priorities.mediumDesc: Requires follow-up but is not urgent. Includes order status questions, pricing inquiries, product availability, and delivery scheduling.
priorities.lowDesc: No immediate action required. Includes general product questions, suggestions, compliments, and non-urgent feedback.

viewDialog.title: Message Details
viewDialog.subtitle: Review full customer message and contact details
viewDialog.markAsReadHint: When marked as read, this cannot be undone. Marking it as read allows this customer to send new messages (as pending messages block new submissions).
viewDialog.confirmWarning: Warning: Marking as read cannot be undone. The customer will now be able to submit new messages.
